messages.subject: For Wang Chuanfu | Electric mobility, government relations and global expansion
messages.body:
Dear BYD Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Wang Chuanfu, Chairman and President.

BYD's international expansion across electric mobility, batteries and energy solutions increasingly depends on disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, communities and strategic partners. That environment closely matches my current leadership responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial renewable-energy and battery-storage platform.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, energy-transition experience and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support BYD's global priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to BYD Company Limited.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
